profile.name: Sensirion SHT85温湿度传感器
profile.name_en: Sensirion SHT85 Temperature and Humidity Sensor
profile.description: 用于实验环境中温度与相对湿度测量的数字传感器，可基于温湿度估算露点。该器件支持不同重复精度、周期性异步采样、ART加速湿度响应以及内部加热器调试功能，通常通过I2C接口集成到实验系统中。
profile.description_en: A digital sensor for measuring temperature and relative humidity in laboratory environments, with dew point estimation based on the measured values. It supports multiple repeatability modes, periodic asynchronous acquisition, ART for faster humidity response, and an internal heater for debugging, typically integrated through an I2C interface.
